_comment: Toolchain pins, measured on the Windows laptop 2026-11-04 (docs/phase3/decisions.md decision 13; decision 15 pins python everywhere). Version numbers only: no vendor build strings. core/util/platform.py reads it at import; scripts/ue_preflight.ps1 compares every installed tool against it and refuses by name (toolchain.<tool>_mismatch). Per-platform tools carry one entry per platform; null means not yet recorded on that machine (never compared, reported UNRECORDED). Keys starting with _ are ignored by readers.
